lib.rs — Crate root with private modules and pub re-exports
The svg_engine crate is a dependency of servo-layout. It receives fully resolved DOM attributes and Stylo ComputedValues,
produces typed render inputs, resolves geometry, and pushes WebRender display items. No DOM access within the crate.
